scope: Ordinary checking of configuration fixtures, including fixtures normally used for DFID/simulation tests; those modes are not certified.
agreement_meaning: Shadow agreement against the reference engine, with successor sampling and independently validated required core words. Not a comparison against pinned TLC goldens; no TLC parity credit is added.

main_equivalence.scope: checker/runtime and fixture input trees; verified separately by the lead
main_equivalence.execution_attribution: All executions remain attributed to backend 2d55317a and harness 366e06c9; main was not rerun by this census.

selection.qualification: Current candidate population, not the historical 1269/1348 handover population; original historical totals remain unreconciled.
selection.population_basis: All configuration fixtures in the actual candidate checkout, with parser exclusions and ambiguous skips explicitly counted; no claim that historical populations were identical.

case_index_meaning: Indexes in profile status/cause lists refer to non_agree_cases. Every original non-agree case is retained, including refusals and timeouts. Agree rows retain their exact original counts in the archived reports.

named-core-refusal.description: The core returned a named refusal; no shadow agreement is credited.

native-budget-stop.description: A native time or memory budget stopped the run; no completion is credited.

sample-level-context.description: The sampled reference evaluation lacks TLCGet("level") context; full-run observables match.

trace-ending-metadata.description: The trace ending claim differs from the reported ending/error class; independent confirmation did not pass.

trace-terminal-constraint.description: The final recorded state is rejected by constraint validation.

trace-terminal-action-constraint-error.description: Validation re-raises an action-constraint error on the final recorded transition.

trace-terminal-implied-action-error.description: Validation re-raises an implied-action error on the final recorded transition.

trace-expansion-unconfirmed.description: Terminal expansion-error replay remains explicitly unsupported by the independent validator.

trace-document-missing.description: The required counterexample document is absent; no agreement is credited.

cause_qualification: Descriptive triage grouping only; findings are neither waived nor reclassified, and existing related issues do not assert all grouped cases are already fixed.

external_preservation.verified: local SHA-256 and regular-file archive inspection; S3 object length and sha256 metadata confirmed

preservation: Original result directory and failed job status remain untouched; any later rerun must use a distinct output location.
